Small AAC and video-rejection regression fixtures from the music-metadata project:

- voice-sample.m4a: test/samples/mp4/Apple%20%20voice%20memo.m4a
- video-sample.mp4: test/samples/mp4/mp4-audio-video.mp4

Source: https://github.com/Borewit/music-metadata/tree/master/test/samples/mp4
The upstream library is MIT licensed. These files are test inputs only and are
never bundled by the app. Their metadata duration is verified without playback.
